# Tradebd (tradebd.online)

> Tradebd is a free financial education academy, technical analysis chart platform, and real-time virtual paper trading simulator for Forex and Cryptocurrency markets in Bengali and English.

## About
Tradebd provides free market education, live candlestick charts with customizable indicators (EMA, SMA, Bollinger Bands, RSI, Volume), a risk-free paper trading simulator with customizable balances ($50 to $10,000,000), global trading session clocks converted to Bangladesh Standard Time (BST / UTC+6), an economic calendar, and comprehensive technical analysis guides.

## Core Features
- **Live Candlestick Chart**: Interactive charts for BTC/USDT, ETH/USDT, EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, and XAU/USD.
- **Paper Trading Simulator**: Long/Short execution, custom leverage, automated stop-loss and take-profit targets, zero real-money risk.
- **Trading Academy**: Step-by-step guides from beginner basics to advanced market structure, price action, and risk management.
- **Candlestick Pattern Gallery**: Visual cheat sheet and reference guide for 18+ high-probability candlestick patterns.
- **Economic Calendar & Global Sessions**: Live countdowns and session tracker for Sydney, Tokyo, London, and New York in BST (UTC+6).
- **Position Size & Lot Calculator**: Calculates lot size, pip value, and risk-to-reward ratio.
- **Educational Trading Blog**: Bilingual articles in Bengali and English covering forex trading strategies, risk management, and market psychology.
